tldr: Signed fold-first local-polynomial donor quadrature attains the original-data efficiency bound uniformly over the declared binary conditional H\"older class for \(s>d/2\), with consistent original-gradient studentization and \(95\%\) Wald coverage. For the specified fully refitted minimum-total-Euclidean-length positive comparator at \(P_*\), the fitted-answer theorem proves original-gradient ALR and \(95\%\) coverage for \(d\le3\), an exact root-\(n\) expansion and corrected CLT using the observable \(D_n/25\) correction for \(d=4\), and \(n^{-2/d}\) drift plus mean bias for \(d>4\).
